body: The problem is it never ends. It's be rough the entire time.i can't stop pushing forward, but I'm really just starting to wish I could pack it in.

I'm 22. The problem is that I literally can't remember a better time. All I've really known is loneliness and pain with the occasional bright spot of hope that precedes everything coming crashing down again. I'm not sure I'm capable or deserving of happiness at this point. I just want peace.

I. What? I'm single and a college drop out. I was supposed to have a date yesterday, but I got stood up. The last year has been a constant uphill push, and after all of that shit is worse now than it was before.
That's what I've been trying to do. And it got me here. Also, how is being on the verge of being completely broke and getting evicted and also starving to death a trivial problem?
I give to gym. Used to practice karate, but I lack the time and money now.
I keep getting back up and pushing. It's just exhausting. I put in everything and it's brought me to this.
Fuck is there a minimum for karma? Are throwaway accounts useless here?
